claims: WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas (Paradise, Nevada).
Official tickets and travel packages for WrestleMania 42 are already available through Ticketmaster.
Visit Las Vegas notes that WrestleMania 42 marks the second consecutive year that WrestleMania is held at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
